newsitem.title: QATAR: Ramadan slump continues to weigh on Qatar stocks.
newsitem.headline: Ramadan slump continues to weigh on Qatar stocks.

text.p: Sluggish Ramadan trade at Qatar's unofficial stock market continued to depress shares for the fourth straight week, brokers said on Thursday.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 18-share index shed 0.5 points to 126.20 from 126.70 points in the previous week.
Five shares advanced in the week to Thursday amid speculation of higher 1996 profits. Three stocks declined and 10 were unchanged.

Gainers included Doha Bank Ltd which extended last week's gains and rose three riyals to 295. Qatar General Insurance which gained five riyals to 615. Al Khaleej Insurance and Qatar Cinema moved up two riyals each to 302 and 182 respectively. Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company crept up half a riyal to 56.5.
Among the week's decliners were Qatar Navigation, which lost 20 riyals to 760 and Qatar Insurance 10 riyals to 540. Qatar Shipping shed half a riyal to 47.5.
During the week to next Thursday, the market will remain closed due to the Eid al-Fitr holidays.
On February 25, Qatar Navigation will hold its annual general meeting and is expected to announce a pay-out of 45 percent of the capital in cash dividend -- the same as in 1995.
